game_title: Range Check Bridge – Sunken Wreck Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Coastal Port – Sunken Wreck, a wreck beneath the waves: the harbor master must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Sunken Wreck: a wreck beneath the waves
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunken Wreck, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Each round, a new cargo crates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the bridge_load value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 210 points of cargo crates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 210, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Check Bridge' (Week 3 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sunken Wreck'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge_load changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Sunken Wreck.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 210 within 63 seconds.
